contacts.name: Unc
pass: That is how your father did it. Quieter, but that is how.
Good. Eat something. Then come back.
I knew it. Do not tell anybody I said that.
fail: It happens. Do not let it happen twice.

contacts.name: Dee
pass: On time and in one piece. I could cry.
Money is counted. You are officially my favorite today.
Not a scratch I can bill you for. Shame.
fail: That is coming out of your cut. All of it.
My grandmother drives better, and she is not allowed to.

contacts.name: Rook
pass: You are useful. Stay that way.

contacts.name: Sal
pass: Forty years on these docks, and you still surprised me.
Clean work. The tide owes you one.
Good. Now nobody saw you here.
fail: The harbor is full of men who almost did it.
Go dry off and try again.

missions.title: Bag Back
brief: Unc: "You still got your feet under you. Sit down."
Unc: "A mugger went for your bag, then his boys, then a Red Kings car."
You: "I saw the car."
missions.intro: Unc: "He dropped your bag up the street. Grab it and bring it back. Then we talk real work."

missions.title: Corner Collection
brief: Unc: "Three corners on the Eastside owe me an envelope."
You: "And if they are short?"
Unc: "They will not be short. Not today."
missions.intro: Unc: "Three envelopes, three corners. Back here before the clock runs out."

missions.title: Chop Job
brief: Unc: "My guy at the chop shop is short one muscle car."
You: "Any color?"
Unc: "Fast is the only color that matters."
missions.intro: Unc: "Find a muscle car and drop it at the chop shop on the marker."

missions.title: Take Over
brief: Unc: "Look around. This block is ours because we hold it."
Unc: "Now we hold one more."
missions.intro: Unc: "Time to grow. Take the block on the marker."

missions.title: Package Run
brief: Dee: "So you are the one Unc keeps talking about."
Dee: "A package came in on the Harbor side. Nobody touches it but you."
missions.intro: Dee: "Harbor drop, then straight back to me. You got 150 seconds."
missions.handoff: Unc: "Go see Dee in Midtown. She runs the garage, and she needs a driver."

missions.title: Clean Delivery
brief: Dee: "That lowrider out front took me six weeks."
Dee: "The buyer is Downtown. He pays for paint, not dents."
missions.intro: Dee: "Drive the lowrider to the marker Downtown. Keep it clean."

missions.title: Shadow
brief: Dee: "Somebody is moving product through my streets and not paying."
Dee: "Do not stop him. Just see where he goes."
missions.intro: Dee: "Follow the marked car. Stay back, but do not lose it."

missions.title: Loop Time
brief: Dee: "You want the fast jobs, I need to know you are fast."
Dee: "One lap of the Loop. The whole ring."
missions.intro: Dee: "Get a car, hit every marker around the Loop. 170 seconds."

missions.title: Repo
brief: Dee: "A customer just drove off without paying."
Dee: "Stop that car. Ram it or take it at a light, I do not care which."
missions.intro: Dee: "Stop the marked car before it gets away."

missions.title: Send a Message
brief: Rook: "You hear what the Red Kings been saying about your people?"
You: "I heard."
Rook: "Then go make them stop saying it."
missions.handoff: Dee: "You drive fine. Rook wants you Downtown. That is the real work."

missions.title: Blue Notice
brief: Rook: "Blue Hand thinks the Red Kings were a one off."
Rook: "Show them it is a policy."

missions.title: Hold the Line
brief: Rook: "They are coming for one of your blocks. Tonight."
Rook: "Lose it and everybody in this city knows you can be pushed."
missions.intro: Rook: "Get to your block on the marker and hold it."

missions.title: Lose Them
brief: Rook: "Somebody gave the police your name."
Rook: "They are already looking. Disappear."
missions.intro: Rook: "You are wanted. Shake the police."

missions.title: The Lieutenant
brief: Rook: "The Red Kings have a lieutenant who plans every raid."
Rook: "Put him on the ground and the raids get stupid."
missions.intro: Rook: "Knock out the Red Kings lieutenant on the marker."

missions.title: Dock Pickup
brief: Sal: "Rook says you are useful. We will see."
Sal: "Four crates on the docks. Gold Line does not know they are there yet."
missions.intro: Sal: "Four crates, then back to me. 170 seconds."
missions.handoff: Rook: "Sal runs the freight at the Harbor. Tell him I sent you."

missions.title: Hot Cargo
brief: Sal: "The van is loaded and the police know the plate."
Sal: "Get it to your side of town anyway."
missions.intro: Sal: "Drive the van to your home block. They will be on you."

missions.title: Gold Standard
brief: Sal: "Gold Line has a captain on these docks. He taxes every load."
Sal: "I am done paying."
missions.intro: Sal: "Knock out the Gold Line captain on the marker."

missions.title: Six Blocks
brief: Sal: "You fight well. Holding ground is different."
Sal: "Come back when six blocks answer to you."

missions.title: Run the City
brief: Unc: "One block. That is what we had."
Unc: "Now look at the map. One more, and nobody tells you no."
missions.intro: Unc: "Take the rival block on the marker. This is the one that counts."
missions.handoff: Sal: "Go home. Unc has one more thing to say to you."
